reason: I've had left-sided chest pain after falling off my bike.
diagnosis: Traumatic left-sided chest pain, most likely from chest wall contusion or rib fracture, suggested by direct impact to the chest, pleuritic worsening with deep breaths, and progressive pain after the fall.
keyPoints: Exact mechanism of injury and point of impact
Pleuritic features and severity of chest pain
Any shortness of breath, hypoxia, or worsening respiratory distress
Red flags after trauma: loss of consciousness, head injury, dizziness, vomiting
Associated injuries: rib pain, shoulder pain, abdominal pain, bruising/scrapes
Risk factors that may complicate recovery: heavy smoking, anticoagulant use, prior lung disease
Allergies and past medical/surgical history relevant to ED treatment
